origin: Built-in ImageGen, owner-approved Lật lại story illustrations, 2026-10-11
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent PNG asset for the Vietnamese used-book website Lật lại. Reference image is the established character identity/style ONLY: preserve its burgundy-red round penguin silhouette, small crest, cream face and belly, tiny golden yellow beak and feet, peach cheeks, dark burgundy clean varying-weight outlines and charming asymmetry. Hand-drawn children's book editorial illustration, crisp flat shapes with extremely subtle warm paper texture, limited palette wine #5c0202, cream #fcf8db, warm butter yellow #f4cb67, peach and muted walnut wood. One coherent little scene, entirely visible with generous transparent margin. No background rectangle, no lettering/text, no logo, no badges, no confetti, no gradients, no photorealism or 3D. Keep actual alpha transparent between all objects. Scene: A little book auction corner, penguin on right behind a low burgundy counter holding a small gold and wine gavel aloft, one closed cream book prominently resting on a small wooden display stand to left. Behind it a modest stack of two differently sized books; a small hanging shop lamp above left gives visual enclosure but no backdrop. Expressive friendly anticipation, not a sale won or money celebration. Landscape composition about 3:2, clearly separated silhouette, all details readable when displayed at 300px. No clock, bid numbers, money, checked seal, labels or text.

Targeted edit:
Edit the provided auction illustration. Preserve exactly the friendly burgundy and cream penguin holding a golden gavel, book on display stand, stack of books, lamp, counter, palette, outlines, texture and overall composition. Remove EVERY colored glow, ambient haze, soft lighting cloud and background gradient around or behind all objects. The area around objects must be entirely truly transparent, sharp clean silhouette; no emitted glow from lamp or gavel. Lamp bulb may remain solid cream/yellow. Generous transparent margin. No other changes. This production asset will sit on a light cream web page and must match the other flat story illustrations. No text.
processing: Delivery resize/encode only; complete composition preserved, no recoloring or compositing
